name: Orsei Baobab-Yuzu Tonic
description: A mid-tier sparkling tonic blending real baobab extract with synth-yuzu citrus, lightly bittered with quinine analogue. Positioned as a mixer but popular on its own among Tier 3 consumers who want 'something adult.'
flavor_profile: Tart citrus brightness, earthy baobab body, a clean quinine bitterness at the back, and a dry finish with faint floral notes.
cultural_context: Orsei sits in an awkward commercial middle ground — too expensive for casual Tier 2 purchase and too unglamorous for Tier 3 status signaling. Its loyalty base is working professionals who genuinely like the taste and resent being told what to drink.
story_hooks: Orsei's real baobab extract supply chain runs through a contested agricultural zone outside Meridian — someone is raiding the shipments and it's not clear if it's a rival corp or a political faction.
A bartender in a Tier 3 lounge has been secretly watering down Orsei and pocketing the difference; their regulars are starting to notice something is off.
An Orsei sales rep is convinced their product is being used as a chemical carrier by someone in their distribution network and brings this suspicion to the wrong person.
